default_jql: project IS NOT EMPTY ORDER BY created DESC

report_templates.all_issues: project IS NOT EMPTY ORDER BY created DESC
report_templates.open_bugs: issuetype = Bug AND resolution = Unresolved ORDER BY priority DESC
report_templates.my_open_issues: assignee = currentUser() AND resolution = Unresolved ORDER BY updated DESC
report_templates.sprint_active: sprint in openSprints() ORDER BY rank ASC
